method.burst_implementation: sendmmsg groups of up to 64, absolute sleeps after each offered burst
method.percentile_method: sample index floor(p*n), capped at n-1; p99 is the maximum when n<=100

decision.burst512_candidate_only: queue drops reduced, but early client drops and variable tail latency remain
